ev.q: Eighty-seven percent of nomad KIs reported camp residents consumed unsafe water sometime during the year.
Among village KIs, 75% were aware of dracunculiasis, 55% knew how to prevent the disease
residents of 116 (55%) of 210 villages and 13 (87%) of 15 nomad camps consumed water from unsafe sources

methods_quotes.q: A cross-sectional survey among sedentary and nomadic populations was conducted.
Nomad camps were selected by convenience, based on recommendations from the Ministry of Livestock and Animal Resources
One KI in each selected village and nomad camp was interviewed using a questionnaire.
Not all key informants responded to each question.
